Adventure Industries — Amazon PDP Image Wireframe

This wireframe maps out the seven gallery images for every Adventure Industries product on Amazon, across Beaver Butter, HushVibes and Rock Candy. The images run in the order a shopper swipes through them: the main image that earns the click first, the closing image that points to the next product last.

How to walk through it: pick a product under its brand. Each card shows an example image (a third party layout reference only), a short visual description of our version, and the copy for that image. Red lines are required safety notes; yellow lines are details we still need from you.
